title: How/Who was ...? How did ...?
text: How did his dreams come true?
Cai Lun was a great Chinese inventor. He lived in the Han Dynasty. He liked making things.

At that time, people often wrote on bamboo or silk. But bamboo was heavy and silk was dear. Cai Lun wanted to use cheap things to make paper. It was very difficult at first, but he did not give up. He kept thinking and trying. Finally, he made cheap but good paper.
Cai Lun's paper helped more people read and write. It was very important.
sentences: How did his dreams come true?
